entries.52d3d7fe99783afb: It has revised its vision for 2030 to "an indispensable ESG niche top company" and positions its new medium-term management plan "Nitto RISE 2028" as its second step. The key initiative is "realizing new growth through Double Certification," and it says it will create and expand products and services that meet the criteria of both the certification of products and services with an especially high contribution to the environment and humanity (PlanetFlags / HumanFlags) and Global Niche Top / Area Niche Top, which aims for No.1 share in niche areas. It makes "Digital Interface," "Green Tech" and "Human Life" its priority fields, and says it will transform its business portfolio by concentrating management resources on the areas of digital and next-generation information and communications, semiconductors, environment and renewable energy, and life sciences. For each reportable segment, it cites examples such as building a new plant at the Toyohashi Plant in Industrial Tape in anticipation of expanding demand for electrically peelable tape for battery fixing, focusing on high-end products for in-vehicle displays and foldable smartphones in Optronics, and putting new plants in Japan and the United States into full operation in Human Life in preparation for increasing demand for nucleic acid medicine contract manufacturing.

entries.687a1c28dafe16ea: It has product-based business divisions, with Industrial Tape, Optronics and Human Life as its three reportable [[term:segment|segments]], and treats new businesses and other items as 'Other'. Industrial Tape covers foundation functional materials such as bonding and protective materials; Optronics covers information functional materials such as optical films and circuit materials such as CIS and high-precision substrates; Human Life covers life science products such as nucleic acid contract manufacturing and medical-related materials, polymer separation membranes, and personal care materials for sanitary materials. Production is generally made to forecast based on demand trends, and some products are made to order.

entries.78f4eb1cb5816c33: This business covers nucleic acid contract manufacturing, nucleic acid synthesis materials, nucleic acid drug discovery, medical-related materials and related products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased from the prior year. Demand rose for nucleic acid contract manufacturing and the nucleic acid materials used in it (NittoPhase™), and from the second quarter of the consolidated fiscal year production began on a large project expected to be commercialized in the future. In nucleic acid drug discovery, a Phase 1 clinical trial of a drug for intractable cancer was completed in the first quarter of the prior year's consolidated fiscal year, and activities toward out-licensing continue.

entries.985268a0aff487c2: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,028,171 million, an increase of 1.4% from ¥1,013,878 million in the previous fiscal year. Revenue from external customers was ¥524,598 million for Optronics, ¥364,827 million for Industrial Tape, ¥137,246 million for Human Life and ¥11 million for Others. It is explained that demand for products increased as production volumes of high-end smartphones and IT equipment exceeded expectations, and that in nucleic acid contract manufacturing, projects for major diseases moved from the clinical stage to the commercialization stage. The exchange rate against the US dollar was ¥150.2 to 1 US dollar, a yen appreciation of 1.7% from the previous fiscal year.

entries.c536d99aa0411757: This business produces the "Foundation Functional Materials," including tapes that bond, protect and assist processing of products and parts. It includes bonding materials, protective materials, process materials and automotive materials. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥364,827 million, up from ¥348,960 million in the prior year (as restated). Demand rose for assembly components for high-end smartphones (such as expanded adoption of electrically peelable tapes for battery fixing) and for process materials used in producing semiconductor memory and ceramic capacitors. On the other hand, automotive materials declined in revenue due to lower automobile production volumes of Japanese manufacturers in China.

entries.cce5852e1956c2f6: This business covers polymer separation membranes. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue fell short of the prior year. entries.d2a89d3a35b80cbe: As of March 31, 2026, the group consists of NITTO DENKO CORPORATION, 87 [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]] and one affiliate. The number of employees at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 26,477, and the consolidated financial statements are prepared under [[term:ifrs|IFRS]]. Founded in 1918 as Nitto Denki Kogyo to produce electrical insulating materials domestically, the company states in its management philosophy mission: 'Contributing to customers' value creation with new ideas.'

This was down from ¥537,852 million in the prior year (as restated).
